status: Written before feature extraction or evaluation; submit in public tranche lock before any audit access. These disjoint sets of archival native TRAIN parents are not a pristine holdout relative to the historical campaign.
cohort: beta 3.05, native TRAIN order, [0,4096) fit, [4096,4608) development, [4608,5120) audit only after a public lock and explicit release. Independently equilibrated parent is sampling unit. No trajectories, modified boxes, physical state generation, native validation/test, index 6 or cold reserves.
observables: Stored spatial axes z,y,x. Use all unordered nearest-neighbor bonds with q=1/24000, equal-species null attempts included; ideal a=min(1,exp(-beta*dE)) preserves canonical reversibility. The historical native CPU uses finite 64-bit acceptance thresholds; no spectral theorem asserted for that rounded implementation. N=8000 attempts per sweep, hence 8000*D/Var is a linear unit conversion only, not an N-step estimate.

19.basis: w(x)=cos(2*pi*x/20). Microscopic A, B, and occupied-owner coordination penalty n*(m-ell_s)^2 summed with w(site). Fixed even-grid tiles: t=cos(2*pi*(anchor_x+0.5)/20); define s_i=sum_v (-1)^v_i 1(vacant_v). Sum t*sum_i s_i^2, a period-two vacancy-order proxy. Augment with t-weighted counts of historical codec/codec.npz lut labels 0,1,2 (3 baseline). No refitting of the historical code, ensemble-independent active coefficients learned from new fit only. Nonzero k excludes invariant density totals and sum of four label indicators is redundant.
19.statistics: For each parent compute exact all-bond Dirichlet matrix 1/2 sum_e q a_e dF_e dF_e^T. Whiten scaled fit covariance, drop eigenvalues <=1e-10 times largest, minimize D in retained subspace; report dimensions and coefficients. Fit n=256,1024,4096; largest rung primary, no dev-driven selection. Evaluate frozen fields on separate dev/audit parents with unbiased sample variance. Contrast 1-Raug/Rbase, report individual D, variance, raw/relative rate difference with paired parent influence intervals, overlap R^2 in microscopic density span. Practical primary improvement >=0.05; no lifetime or gap lower bound. Prediction: improvement <0.05.
19.control: Unbiased hot nearest-neighbor exchange drift on each observed density wave must equal -2(1-cos(k))/(3N) times F, independent of the archived sampling law. Cross-check weighted owner energy delta against the tested integer stencil for uniform weights. Constant and equal-label attempts have zero changes.

20.geometry: Every r, e=(r,r+x), f=(r+y,r+y+x); far uses f=(r+5y,r+5y+x), same orientation. Eligible iff e and f each joins unlike labels. Eligibility is symmetric under e and unchanged under f. Both directions of each unordered e give the same event. Primary is conditional on these eligible pairs, not selected mobile sites; report unconditional mass if all 8000 anchors count.
20.estimands: At frozen threshold 1/2 and a_f(old)<1/2<=a_f(after e), O=E[sum_eligible a_e I(open)]/E[number eligible]. Closure is reverse crossing. Also report signed O-C, accept-flux-weighted positive acceptance change on crossings (per eligible and per weighted opening), raw opening and closing counts, a_e sums and reverse pairing error. Compare practical O>=0.001 per eligible; predict O>=0.001. Detailed balance pairs reversible-equilibrium opening with closing, not net signed creation. Far cross effect exactly zero by disjoint owner sets; hot all gates initially open. No claim about finite-time cascading or relaxation.
20.symbol: Among f initially closed, match on exact (max(dE_e,0),dE_f) integer barrier pair. Standardize each of the four labels of the nonoverlapping frozen tile containing the left endpoint of f to the pooled fit masses of exact barrier pairs with >=32 eligible rows of every label in fit. Report predeclared label 3 minus 0 standardized opening probability, all label rates, retained fit and supported evaluation mass; renormalize to common identified barrier strata only if a split contains an empty stratum, with disclosed coverage. No assignment of causal symbol effects, no selection of strongest label pair. Parent intervals conditional on fit standardization.

uncertainty: Whole-parent paired delta-method Student 95% intervals. Decision terminology: resolved above/below floor only when whole interval above/below; otherwise unresolved. Development and audit reported separately. Small familywise sensitivity intervals for two prespecified primary contrasts at 97.5% each. No global correction across this exploratory tranche.
